$comment: Benchmark decks from sub-phase 0.8. The decks themselves are NOT committed - the largest is 188 MiB - so what is here is the recipe, the exact size and the SHA-256 of the file that recipe produces. The generator is deterministic, so anyone can rebuild a deck and check they have the same one. `storage: "generated"` is what says so: such an entry carries an `outputName` and never a `path`, because there is no file in the repository to point at.
$embeddedFont: Every recipe here embeds the CC0 probe font this project authored in sub-phase 0.7 - `probe-eot-v2-2` in corpus/ground-truth/manifest.json - and a run on the first slide uses it. Nothing anyone else owns is inside a file this project hands around.

entries.sourceNote: measurements taken by tools/bench/run-bench.ts on this project's own decks
entries.description: Parse timings for the three recipes below, taken in one Chromium on one machine on one day: per-stage inflate, decode, tokenize and census figures, plus the worker environment probe. A record and not a fixture - nothing asserts on these numbers, because a slower laptop is not a regression. Sub-phase 3.9's digest-pinned container is what makes a timing comparable across machines.

entries.sourceNote: generated by tools/bench/deck.ts from the `media-200mb` recipe
entries.description: The plan's own envelope for sub-phase 0.8: 300 slides at about 200 MB, dominated by media, which is the shape a real large deck has. Every image is incompressible noise, because a deck padded with zeroes deflates away and the ZIP reader then never does the work a real file makes it do. Opens in PowerPoint 365 with no repair prompt: 300 slides, 6 sections, and 5191 shapes - the same number the generator allocated ids for.

entries.sourceNote: generated by tools/bench/deck.ts from the `small` recipe
entries.description: Twenty slides with every feature at least twice, for opening in PowerPoint by hand and for the test suite. tools/bench/bench.test.ts builds this recipe and checks the census finds exactly the features the generator put in, in both directions - two independently written counts of the same file. Opens in PowerPoint 365 with no repair prompt.

entries.sourceNote: generated by tools/bench/deck.ts from the `xml-heavy` recipe
entries.description: The same 300 slides with no media and 400 shapes each. The media deck cannot exercise the tokenizer at all - 184 of its 188 MiB never reach the XML layer - and this one is the case whose throughput actually predicts anything about phase 2 onwards. It also probes the decompression budget: 4.4 MiB in, 87 MiB out, a 20:1 ratio across the archive.
